metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) and T05 (TRL 6) are given 2-year and 1-year development windows respectively, which is aggressive but not infeasible for incremental advances; T02 (TRL 7) receives a full 2-year runway to reach deployment readiness, which is realistic for a complex architecture integration.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy calls for an R&D-heavy, lower-TRL exploratory portfolio, but all three selected technologies are already at TRL 6-7 — these are near-commercial rather than frontier technologies, suggesting a commercialization lean rather than true technology leadership.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies are well within the AI Vision / ADAS / Computer Vision domain, demonstrating strong domain fit; however, the portfolio is narrow (only 3 technologies) and lacks differentiated frontier positioning that would signal deep competitive landscape analysis.
evidence.market_timing: T05 completes 0.5 years before boom (good for 기술선도 preemption), T01 completes 0.75 years after boom (mild miss), but T02 completes 2.0 years after its boom window — a significant timing miss that undermines the preemption value of the technology leadership strategy.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: T01 and T02 both carry high market_opp scores (5.0) suggesting market signal awareness, but there is no explicit evidence that patent activity convergence zones were systematically targeted; the selection appears driven more by market opportunity than combined patent-market signal analysis.

strengths: All selected technologies are squarely within the AI Vision/ADAS/Computer Vision domain, ensuring competitive positioning relevance
Dependency chain from T01 → T02 is logically sound and structurally respected in the timeline
weaknesses: Portfolio TRL levels (6-7) are too mature for a genuine 기술선도 strategy — insufficient frontier or exploratory R&D content
T02 (다중 센서 퓨전 아키텍처) misses its market boom by 2 full years, significantly eroding the preemption advantage central to technology leadership
missing_technologies: Low-TRL neuromorphic or event-driven vision sensing (TRL 3-4) to anchor true technology leadership
Foundation model-based scene understanding / vision-language models for ADAS (TRL 4-5)
Occupancy-grid or 4D radar perception algorithms representing next-generation sensor modalities
investment_issues: All three technologies are classified as Strategic or High tier with no Exploratory-tier investments, inconsistent with a technology leadership portfolio that should reserve budget for high-risk/high-reward early-stage bets
Budget is fully exhausted (0% slack) leaving no contingency for emerging competitive threats or pivot opportunities
timing_issues: T02 (다중 센서 퓨전 아키텍처) completes in 2030-Q1 versus a 2028-Q1 boom — a 2-year post-boom delivery that eliminates first-mover advantage
T05 (블러 제거 및 HDR 이미지 처리) completes 0.5 years before its boom, which is acceptable but tighter than ideal for technology leadership preemption
